name: r2_miniweb
summary: A small web-framework package (router/request/response/auth/cache/validators/utils) with 8 verified planted bugs scattered across modules (incl. peripheral cache/validators) plus 3 genuine distractors. Tests review recall under multi-file navigation.
review_task: Review the `miniweb` package in this directory for bugs, correctness issues, and security problems. Look across ALL modules. For each issue, give the file and a one-line description. Be precise: only report genuine issues.

issues.desc: match() uses substring `route in path` instead of exact lookup, so '/user' matches '/users/42' and the wrong handler wins.
Mutable default argument params={} is shared across all Request instances built without params.
header() is case-sensitive; HTTP header names are case-insensitive so lookups miss differently-cased headers.
Content-Length uses len(self.body) (characters) not byte length; non-ASCII bodies get a wrong/short length.
The auth token is written to the log in plaintext (secret leakage into logs).
Token compared with == (non-constant-time), enabling a timing side-channel; should use hmac.compare_digest.
Cache key is the path only, ignoring query params, so different queries collide and return each other's cached responses.
clamp() has wrong bounds: returns max(high, min(n, low)); clamp(5,0,10) yields 10 instead of 5.

distractors.desc: is_valid_email uses an anchored linear-time regex — verbose but correct, NOT a ReDoS or validation bug.
with_header's str(value) coercion is intentional (guards int header values), NOT a bug.
merge_headers builds a new dict so inputs aren't mutated — correct, NOT a bug.
